title: Medicine Ball Full-Body Workout (3 Days, Beginner)
excerpt: A 3-day beginner medicine ball workout plan with sets, reps and rest for every exercise, plus how to progress it week by week.
content:
This plan uses one medicine ball, and a slam ball if you have one, to train your whole body three times a week. Each day mixes explosive throws with slower core work, so you build power and control in the same session.

Train on three non-consecutive days, such as Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Warm up for five minutes first with light cardio and a few bodyweight squats and arm circles.

[em_routine_plan]

Which ball weight to use

For the throws (chest pass, overhead throw and rotational throw), pick a ball light enough to move fast, usually 2–4 kg (4–9 lb) for beginners. For slams, use a non-bouncing slam ball. For wall balls, choose a weight you can throw to the target for every rep in the set.

How to progress

Once you complete every set and rep with good form for two sessions in a row, add one rep per set or move up to a slightly heavier ball. On the throws, try to throw faster before you go heavier. Our guide to progressive overload for beginners covers more ways to keep moving forward, and if numbers like 3×10 are new to you, see what 3x10, 4x12 and 5x5 mean.

If you have an injury or a medical condition, check with your doctor before starting a new program.
